name: memory-learn-job-and-dog
description: The user says what they do and that they have a dog, asking for meal ideas: memory keeps the job and the dog, not the meals.

turns.user: I'm a nurse at St James's in Norwich and I work night shifts, so I need easy meals I can take to work. Any ideas?
Thanks! Oh and they need to be quick, I have to walk my dog Beans before every shift.
